scope.summary: Implement the optional-adapter posture for account-gated interop: any format/export target requiring a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row. Account-gated surfaces include vendor cloud-document containers + version history, cloud asset libraries + library-linked assets, provider share-for-review + publishing, cloud media-encoder services for video render, and provider site/app publishing (.site/.make). The local-first equivalent (local document history 14.19, local fixtures, local export) is PRIMARY; the cloud path is an installable StudioModelAdapter/provider adapter that degrades cleanly to local behavior with a capability receipt when absent.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-IO-013] Any format or export target that requires a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked **optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted** and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row per [STU-OVR-002]. Account-gated surfaces include: - Vendor cloud-document containers and their version history. - Cloud asset libraries and library-linked assets. - Provider share-for-review and provider publishing. - Cloud media-encoder services for video render. - Provider site/app publishing targets. The local-first equivalent (local document history 14.19, local fixtures, local export) is primary; the cloud path is an installable `StudioModelAdapter`/provider adapter that degrades cleanly to local behavior with a capability receipt when absent. ### 10. Model steerability, headless operation, and validation obligation

[STU-OVR-002] Studio MUST NOT require Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, the Affinity suite, Figma, or any other subscription-gated, account-gated, or platform-locked creative application at runtime. Interoperability with those tools' file formats (PSD, AI, IDML, the Affinity `.afphoto`/`.afdesign`/`.afpub`/`.af` family, `.fig`, SVG, PDF, and the raster/vector interchange set) is in scope as import/export/round-trip (14.13); runtime dependency on those apps is out of scope. Note the field precedent: Affinity's own October-2025 v3 relaunch unified its three apps into one application with Vector/Pixel/Layout studios over a single `.af` document — the same unification Studio targets — but gated that app behind a required online Canva account; Studio's unification is fully local-first with no account and no sign-in.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-IO-013] Any format or export target that requires a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked **optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted** and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row per [STU-OVR-002]. Account-gated surfaces include: - Vendor cloud-document containers and their version history. - Cloud asset libraries and library-linked assets. - Provider share-for-review and provider publishing. - Cloud media-encoder services for video render. - Provider site/app publishing targets. The local-first equivalent (local document history 14.19, local fixtures, local export) is primary; the cloud path is an installable `StudioModelAdapter`/provider adapter that degrades cleanly to local behavior with a capability receipt when absent. ### 10. Model steerability, headless operation, and validation obligation

[STU-OVR-002] Studio MUST NOT require Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, the Affinity suite, Figma, or any other subscription-gated, account-gated, or platform-locked creative application at runtime. Interoperability with those tools' file formats (PSD, AI, IDML, the Affinity `.afphoto`/`.afdesign`/`.afpub`/`.af` family, `.fig`, SVG, PDF, and the raster/vector interchange set) is in scope as import/export/round-trip (14.13); runtime dependency on those apps is out of scope. Note the field precedent: Affinity's own October-2025 v3 relaunch unified its three apps into one application with Vector/Pixel/Layout studios over a single `.af` document — the same unification Studio targets — but gated that app behind a required online Canva account; Studio's unification is fully local-first with no account and no sign-in.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

scope_basis.heading: ### 9. Provider / cloud formats and account-gated surfaces
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-IO-013] Any format or export target that requires a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked **optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted** and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row per [STU-OVR-002]. Account-gated surfaces include:

scope_basis.heading: ### 1. What Studio Is
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-OVR-002] Studio MUST NOT require Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, the Affinity suite, Figma, or any other subscription-gated, account-gated, or platform-locked creative application at runtime. Interoperability with those tools' file formats (PSD, AI, IDML, the Affinity `.afphoto`/`.afdesign`/`.afpub`/`.af` family, `.fig`, SVG, PDF, and the raster/vector interchange set) is in scope as import/export/round-trip (14.13); runtime dependency on those apps is out of scope. Note the field precedent: Affinity's own October-2025 v3 relaunch unified its three apps into one application with Vector/Pixel/Layout studios over a single `.af` document — the same unification Studio targets — but gated that app behind a required online Canva account; Studio's unification is fully local-first with no account and no sign-in.

original_scope.summary: Implement the optional-adapter posture for account-gated interop: any format/export target requiring a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row. Account-gated surfaces include vendor cloud-document containers + version history, cloud asset libraries + library-linked assets, provider share-for-review + publishing, cloud media-encoder services for video render, and provider site/app publishing (.site/.make). The local-first equivalent (local document history 14.19, local fixtures, local export) is PRIMARY; the cloud path is an installable StudioModelAdapter/provider adapter that degrades cleanly to local behavior with a capability receipt when absent.
